info.title: devacc ERiC workflow API
info.description: Headless ERiC preparation, validation and SaaS-delegated test review. SaaS users keep their own login and interface; machine OAuth/DPoP authenticates transport while a registered partner authority signs closed actor status and exact decisions. Partner-asserted evidence does not prove direct observation of a user action. Test reviews never authorize filing; separately bound test-transmission consents remain blocked from dispatch until independent qualification. Direct browser software-certificate intake supports encrypted custody and private local inspection; no transmission endpoint is enabled.

get.description: Read an already published test-retrieval preservation. post.summary: Record the client archive assertion for a preserved artifact
post.description: Assert that the SaaS client archived the exact content and provenance bytes at its opaque archive reference. One immutable receipt per artifact; matching assertions, including with a new Idempotency-Key or newer authorized actor revision, return the first receipt. Changed digests or reference conflict. Fresh original retrieval authority and authentic source bytes are required before every write or replay. This is a client assertion, not verification of external storage, an ELSTER mailbox acknowledgement or permission to delete evidence. No remote address is fetched.

post.summary: Plan source-backed fields for an explicit E-Bilanz annual case
post.description: Stateless read-authorized planning, with existing product/tenant DPoP binding and strict case selector. No Idempotency-Key, domain write, outbox, draft, job, native execution or filing authority. Missing pinned taxonomy returns 503. Unsupported cases, malformed selectors and over-limit bodies fail closed. All final values and NIL decisions remain caller-supplied; complete preparation applies authoritative semantic checks.

EBilanzFormPlan.description: Deterministic 4 MiB-bounded form metadata for one supported case. No financial source values, raw archives or inferred tax decisions. This is not preparation, native validation, approval or transmission qualification.

kke_equity_member_roots.description: Source-backed active shareholder-group QName to permitted valued KKE equity-member root QName (6.9 B.19.1). Present in v9 through current v12 plans; absent from earlier historical plans.

EBilanzFormPartnership.description: OHG/KG/GKG/AGKG/GOHG/AGOHG/GBR/PG/ASG/soPG AO/HAOE/HGBM GKV/UKV annual GHB shareholder/KKE linkage. KKE supports tax values only; commercial and transition columns remain unsupported. Typed partner-axis values equal the declared shareholder ID. Required cells apply to each selected concrete equity member and its source presentation ancestors; clients supply all final amounts and NIL decisions. Preparation enforces complete equations.

EBilanzMappingMember.description: Member from a pinned effective dimension domain. Legal-form, date and tax-value restrictions must be respected; independent members do not establish complete BAL or filing validity.

selection_value.description: Exact empty lexical marker for a caller-selected string choice item; supplied only after explicit selection, never for a NIL fact.

value_literal.description: Exact current-case lexical value when reported with state value. The explanation pointer additionally requires explicit source footnote text; the corporate-tax option is not supported as true.

footnote_required.description: A nonblank plain-text footnote is required when this item is reported with state value; no default explanation is supplied.

repeatable.description: Official repeatable top-level tuple; each occurrence has independent child identities.

EBilanzFormField.description: Explicit source-derived field metadata. Required describes ordinary presence. Required_state describes explicit current case constraints; optional selection/ancestor/BAL constraints still apply. No amount or NIL default is returned.

repeatable_children.description: Sequence children whose official xs:element maxOccurs is unbounded; other sequence children remain singletons.

EBilanzContext.description: Exactly one instant or duration period. The module verifies date equality, semantic uniqueness and official dimensions.

EBilanzMappingCatalog.description: Deterministic projection of the configured pinned taxonomy for mapping discovery, bounded to 4 MiB. Raw archives and private source facts are never returned. This is an offline candidate scope, not native qualification, filing approval, or transmission authority.

EBilanzMappingTarget.description: Discoverable monetary target; value_legal_forms is permission for a non-NIL value, not proof of complete filing validity. Date boundaries, declared components, source context, ancestors, calculations and BAL relationships remain subject to preparation validation. Empty dimension_set_ids means an ordinary context without dimensions; otherwise use one complete referenced axis set.

signed_decision.description: Compact EdDSA JWS from the registered product approval authority, bound to the exact mapping revision, challenge, statement and requested action.

EBilanzMappingDocument.description: Confirmed one-to-one classification of final monetary facts. The private pinned taxonomy validates each concept, period kind and dimension; no inferred tax treatment or account aggregation. Maximum document size 64 KiB.

signed_decision.description: Compact EdDSA JWS from the registered product approval authority, bound to the exact mapping revision, challenge, statement and requested action.

archive_reference.description: Opaque client archive locator, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes without control characters or surrounding whitespace. Stored encrypted; never fetched by the service.

ValidationDiagnostics.description: Additive read projection, never approval or submission authority. Findings preserve native order. Parsing is bounded to 4 MiB UTF-8 XML, 4096 findings, 64 semantic indices per finding and 64 KiB per string; findings JSON is capped at 3 MiB and the complete projection at 4 MiB. Unsupported or oversized evidence is unavailable, never truncated. Raw result.xml remains separately readable.

ticket.description: Exact native Nutzdatenticket; never normalized numerically.

locations.description: Proven frozen review/source locations only. An empty array means global or ambiguous; no location is inferred from text.

review_path.description: JSON pointer into the immutable preparation review.json. A finding may reference several contributing inputs.

EBilanzMappedInput.description: Public source-key-mapped E-Bilanz input, at most 512 KiB. Names an exact confirmed revision. Compiler-private snapshots and caller-supplied confirmation are rejected.

footnote.description: Optional plain-text footnote on this item, never interpreted as markup. At most 16 KiB of UTF-8 per note, 128 notes and 128 KiB total per preparation. Blank-only text and non-XML characters fail semantic validation. Line breaks are preserved in the rendered footnote. Tuple footnotes are unsupported.

EBilanzMappedMetadata.description: Explicit E-Bilanz metadata, contexts, GCD facts and account details accompanying mapped monetary facts. The service supplies mapping_version. Explicit facts cannot override mapped target cells or identifiers.

EBilanzFact.description: Closed value, nil item, populated tuple or nil tuple shapes. Nil tuples omit context, unit, value and children. Official concept/type/nillability, total fact count 5000 and tuple depth 4 are enforced by the pinned module.

micro_bilg_prepared.description: Explicit customer assertion that this corporation's statements were prepared under MicroBilG. True selects the fiscal-microbilg entry schema; absent or false selects the ordinary fiscal schema.

EBilanzInput.description: Final reported facts and explicitly mapped Kontensalden under pinned E-Bilanz 6.9 artifacts. No caller-supplied profile, runtime, catalog or procedure overrides. Official semantic/taxonomy relationships, byte bounds and source mapping consistency are validated by the module; this shape is not qualification evidence.

UStVAMappedInput.description: Public source-key-mapped UStVA input. The referenced confirmed mapping revision binds each source_key to a pinned group. Never supply final form fields or compiler-private representations.

UStVAMappedFact.description: Mapped fact input. The confirmed source mapping determines which base/tax fields are valid for its source_key; values remain caller-classified exact EUR amounts.

UStVADerivedMetadata.description: Reporting metadata for classified facts. Final fields and month are forbidden; period is explicit.

UStVADerivedInput.description: Restricted derived EUR mode. Aggregate exact cents before whole-euro projection; fractional aggregate bases fail. Preserve supplied tax cents and derive Kz83 using pinned form rules. Kz50/Kz37 are informational and never counted again in Kz83. Final fields and control/text/date Kennziffer fields are unsupported. Test-marked and unvalidated; no filing permission.

base.description: Exact caller-confirmed EUR amount; no rate calculation.

tax.description: Exact caller-confirmed EUR amount; no rate calculation.

UStVADerivedFact.description: Caller-confirmed annual group and exact amounts. Kz37/Kz39 tax and Kz50 base must be nonnegative per fact. Kz50 and Kz37 are additional informational reductions already reflected in the main groups; they do not affect Kz83. No classification inference; source references need not identify Accounting records.

UStVAInputV2.description: Final reported values, not automatic tax calculation. Every payload remains test-marked. Schema and native plausibility are separate checks.

UserNotice.description: A notice that the SaaS presents before native use. When acknowledgement_offered is true, offer the user an acknowledgement action; retrieval is not presentation or acknowledgement evidence.

DelegatedActorStatus.name: X-ERIC-Actor-Status
DelegatedActorStatus.description: Fresh signed SaaS actor status JWS, bound to the registered authority and this machine client. Not included in mutation idempotency hashes.

FilingHumanAuthorization.name: X-ERIC-Human-Authorization
FilingHumanAuthorization.description: Exactly one Bearer human access token for ebilanz.app. Required for immutable combined_human_required authority versions; rejected for legacy versions. Independently verified alongside the machine DPoP credential, with exact operator binding and current action-specific local human permission through commit. Credentials are never returned.
